title: Mastering Atari Games with Limited Data

methods.one_paragraph_description: Sample-efficient model-based visual RL algorithm built on MuZero. Runs MCTS (50 simulations) in the latent space of a learned model (representation, dynamics, prediction networks) to select actions; adds a self-supervised consistency loss on latent states (SimSiam-style), an end-to-end LSTM 'value prefix' predicting summed rewards over unrolled steps instead of per-step reward, and a model-based off-policy correction that recomputes value targets with a dynamic horizon and MCTS root value (reanalyze). Trained 120k steps with data collected during the first 100k env steps.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: 'We propose a sample efficient model-based visual RL algorithm built on MuZero' (Abstract); 'These MCTS RL algorithms are a hybrid of model-based learning and model-free learning' (Section 2)
